metadata.budget_rule: this SDK's arm only: a USD and a token ceiling of 10 times the kind's median on this SDK's arm in M15 (adr12-comparison-2026-09-16.json); the sandbox kind 10 times the multi-step median; the delegation kind 10 times the sandbox kind's median on this SDK's arm in M51 (adr12-comparison-2026-11-09.json), a child's share reserved from its parent's. The Claude arm has no budget
metadata.delegation: each row reports whether its run delegated and how many children it ran, never a condition of passing: on this SDK's arm the runs whose parent_run_id is the run's, and its usage the whole run's, children included; on the Claude arm its Agent calls whose result was not an error, and its usage as the CLI's result reports it
metadata.networking: this SDK's arm reaches only its task's allowed host, through its workspace's proxy; the Claude arm runs with ordinary networking, to reach the gateway and the fetch tasks' host

delegation.agentsdk: the general preset in a workspace holding the task's files, egress by the task's allow list, every export refused; it runs as uid 65534 (nobody, home /) in the workspace image, which has /bin/sh but no bash; the delegating preset (delegate=True), each child a general subagent in a workspace of its own with the files its call named
delegation.claude-agent-sdk: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write and Edit in a disposable container holding the task's files; it runs as uid 1000 (agent, home /home/agent), and its image adds nodejs, npm and bash (for the Bash tool) to the workspace image's base; and its CLI's own subagent tool, Agent

metadata.verification: code tasks verified by the harness in a fresh container of the workspace image with no network, on visible and hidden cases
